title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement: Given a string s, find the longest contiguous substring that reads the same forwards and backwards (a palindrome). If there are multiple palindromes of equal length, return any one of them.
constraints: s consist of only digits and English letters (lower-case and/or upper-case)

visibleExamples.explanation: Both 'bab' and 'aba' are valid answers; either is acceptable.
A single character is a palindrome.
